question:
**Fill in the blanks:**

The Union Home Minister chairs a Zonal Council meeting as _____ chairman.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ex-officio**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Union Home Minister serves as the **ex-officio chairman** of each Zonal Council in India.
 
• Zonal Councils were established under the **States Reorganisation Act of 1956** to promote interstate cooperation and coordination.
 
• There are five Zonal Councils in India – Northern, Central, Eastern, Western, and Southern – each comprising state
